name: devin-token-monitor
description: Monitor local Devin CLI token usage and estimated cost from VS Code, Cursor, and compatible desktop IDEs.

commands.title: Devin Token Monitor: Select Sessions Database
Devin Token Monitor: Open Price Table

devinTokenMonitor.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path or command name for Python 3.10+. Leave empty to use `python3` (macOS/Linux) or `python` (Windows).

devinTokenMonitor.databasePath.markdownDescription: Path to Devin's `sessions.db`. Leave empty to use the default `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`; supports `~` and environment-variable expansion.

devinTokenMonitor.pricesPath.markdownDescription: Optional custom `prices.json` path. Leave empty to use the extension's persistent user data copy (or the shared `~/.devin-token-monitor/prices.json` when present).

devinTokenMonitor.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show today's estimated cost in the VS Code status bar.

scripts.test: npm run stage && node --test tests/*.test.js && node scripts/test.js
